newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dubai traders, hurt by Iran's closure of transit routes to Afghanistan, wait for Pakistan to resume Afghan transit facility which it closed two years ago.
- Gulf Industrial Corporation invites UAE private sector to invest in four manufacturing projects.
- President Sheikh Zaid urges Arab solidarity at Supreme Council meeting.
- UAE affirms rejection of Turkey's military operation in northern Iraq.
- Sixty German companies set up German Business Council in Abu Dhabi.
- President Sheikh Zaid praises the country's economic growth.
- Value of investment in UAE expected to reach 42.5 billion dirhams in the current year, study.
